dka.text: The Helvault is the silver monolith in which Avacyn is imprisoned, after the demon Griselbrand challenges her at the Helvault, she drives him in, but he impales her and she is imprisoned too.
With Avacyn locked inside, Innistrad is left without a protector and overrun by creatures of the night while humans near extinction.
Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault by threatening her soldiers, unleashing Avacyn and the demons.

avr.text: The Helvault was made by Sorin from a chunk of the silver moon so that Avacyn could seal away threats, and in 4557 AR Griselbrand tricks her into banishing him into it and pulls her in, sealing them both.
Thalia takes an oath never to let the Helvault come to harm, becoming the Guardian of Thraben and unknowingly keeping Avacyn sealed, until Liliana Vess coerces her into letting her shatter it.
A golden helix streaks from the Helvault, which explodes, and Avacyn emerges free from her prison at last, and after its destruction, fearful mobs soon become fearless battalions.
